scope: Full text of the 2023 Volkow and Blanco review of substance use disorders, replacing the opening summary.

keyRecommendations.text: Addiction is used for moderate or severe SUD.
Medications have benefit in opioid, nicotine, and alcohol use disorders; behavioral therapies in all SUDs; neuromodulation in nicotine use disorder.
Use a chronic care model. FDA-approved alcohol medications named are disulfiram, acamprosate, and naltrexone. Smoking-cessation medications named are bupropion, varenicline, and nicotine replacement.

clinicalBottomLine: Treat moderate or severe SUD as a chronic illness. Medication is established for opioid, nicotine, and alcohol use disorders, and behavioral therapy for all SUDs.
notableCaveats: The PMC HTML now contains the article body. The earlier file was only the opening summary.

source.title: Substance use disorders: a comprehensive update of classification, epidemiology, neurobiology, clinical aspects, treatment and prevention.
